_meta.description: AiTaxBot Tax Topic Graph — maps Indian tax concept dependencies for agentic RAG. When a concept is detected in a query, all triggered concepts are also fetched from the vector store.
_meta.law_basis: Income Tax Act 2025 (as amended by FA 2026) + IT Rules 2026

standard_deduction.label: Standard Deduction
key_facts: New Regime: Rs.75,000 FY 2025-26 onwards
Old Regime: Rs.75,000 FY 2024-25 onwards

hra.label: HRA Exemption
key_facts: 8 metro cities: Mumbai, Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Ahmedabad
Metro: 50% of basic salary; Non-metro: 40%
Minimum of three conditions

lta.label: Leave Travel Allowance
key_facts: Exempt only in Old Regime
2 journeys in 4-year block
Only domestic travel
Economy class air or AC-1 train

tds_salary.label: TDS on Salary (Section 192)
key_facts: Employer deducts TDS monthly based on estimated annual income
Employee declares investments to employer for TDS reduction
TDS mismatch = notice risk

form_16.label: Form 16 / Form 130
key_facts: Under ITA 2025, Form 16 is renamed Form 130
Part A: TDS summary from TRACES
Part B: Salary breakup and deductions from employer

regime_choice.label: Old vs New Tax Regime
key_facts: New Regime is DEFAULT from FY 2023-24 onwards
Old Regime: opt-in required every year (except business income filers — once opted out, irrevocable until business income ends)
New Regime rebate u/s 87A: Rs.60,000 if income ≤ Rs.12L (effectively zero tax up to Rs.12L)
Old Regime slabs: 0-2.5L nil, 2.5-5L 5%, 5-10L 20%, 10L+ 30%

advance_tax.label: Advance Tax
key_facts: Advance tax applies when tax liability ≥ Rs.10,000 after TDS
Interest under Section 234B for short payment
Interest under Section 234C for deferred instalments
Senior citizens (60+) with no business income: exempt from advance tax

section_80c.label: Section 80C Deductions
key_facts: Maximum: Rs.1,50,000 per year
Available ONLY in Old Regime
Instruments: ELSS, PPF, LIC premium, EPF employee contribution, home loan principal, NSC, ULIP, children's tuition, Sukanya Samriddhi
ELSS lock-in: 3 years (shortest among 80C instruments)
PPF lock-in: 15 years

section_80d.label: Section 80D Health Insurance
key_facts: Available ONLY in Old Regime
Self + family (non-senior): Rs.25,000
Parents (non-senior): Rs.25,000 additional
Senior citizen parents: Rs.50,000 additional
Preventive health checkup: Rs.5,000 within above limits
Cash payment NOT allowed (except preventive checkup)

nps_80ccd1b.label: NPS Section 80CCD(1B)
key_facts: Extra Rs.50,000 deduction beyond 80C limit — available ONLY in Old Regime
Only NPS Tier 1 contributions qualify
At maturity: 60% tax-free withdrawal, 40% mandatory annuity (taxable as pension)
Employer NPS contribution under 80CCD(2): available in BOTH regimes, up to 10% of salary (14% for Central Govt employees)

capital_gains.label: Capital Gains
key_facts: Capital gains are taxed at SPECIAL rates — not regime-dependent
Cannot be set off against salary or other income

equity_stcg.label: STCG on Equity (Listed)
key_facts: Rate: 20% (increased from 15% in Budget 2024, effective 23 Jul 2024)
Applies to: listed equity shares, equity-oriented MF, units of business trust
Condition: STT paid at time of sale
Holding period: < 12 months
Rebate u/s 87A NOT available on STCG after FY 2024-25

equity_ltcg.label: LTCG on Equity (Listed)
key_facts: Rate: 12.5% (increased from 10% in Budget 2024, effective 23 Jul 2024)
Exemption: LTCG up to Rs.1,25,000 per year exempt (increased from Rs.1,00,000)
Condition: STT paid on both buy and sell
Holding period: ≥ 12 months
No indexation benefit
Grandfathering: FMV as on 31 Jan 2018 is deemed cost for pre-2018 holdings

debt_mf.label: Debt Mutual Fund Taxation
key_facts: AFTER April 1 2023: All gains from debt MF taxed at SLAB RATE regardless of holding period (Section 50AA)
No LTCG benefit, no indexation for debt MF purchased after 31 Mar 2023
MFs with ≤35% equity treated as debt — taxed at slab rate

property_gains.label: Property Capital Gains
key_facts: LTCG: Holding ≥ 24 months (2 years) — taxed at 12.5% WITHOUT indexation (Budget 2024 change)
STCG: Holding < 24 months — taxed at slab rate
Exemption 54: Reinvest in residential property within 2 years (purchase) or 3 years (construction)
Exemption 54EC: Invest in specified bonds (NHAI, REC) within 6 months, max Rs.50L

set_off_rules.label: Capital Loss Set-Off Rules
key_facts: STCL can be set off against STCG and LTCG
LTCL can ONLY be set off against LTCG
Cannot set off capital loss against salary or other income
Carry forward: 8 years (must file ITR on time, even if no income)
Intra-head set-off first, then inter-head

crypto_vda.label: Crypto / VDA Taxation
key_facts: Flat 30% tax on any gain — NO deductions allowed except cost of acquisition
Losses from VDA CANNOT be set off against any other income
VDA losses cannot be carried forward
TDS 1% on sale proceeds > Rs.10,000 (Section 194S)
Each transaction is a separate event

itr_form_selection.label: ITR Form Selection
key_facts: ITR-1 (Sahaj): Salary + 1 house property + other income, NO capital gains, income ≤ Rs.50L
ITR-2: Salary + capital gains + multiple house properties, no business income
ITR-3: Business/professional income (non-presumptive) + all other income
ITR-4 (Sugam): Presumptive income under 44AD/44ADA/44AE, income ≤ Rs.50L
From AY 2026-27: ITR-1 and ITR-4 allow 2 house properties

ais_reconciliation.label: AIS / Form 26AS Reconciliation
key_facts: AIS replaced Form 26AS as the primary income statement
AIS shows: salary, interest, dividends, securities transactions, mutual fund purchases, foreign remittances
Mismatch between AIS and ITR → CBDT may send notice under Section 143(1)
Can file feedback on AIS portal to correct wrong entries
Always reconcile AIS before filing

business_income.label: Business / Professional Income
key_facts: 44AD: Presumptive income for small business — 8% of turnover (6% for digital receipts), turnover ≤ Rs.2 crore
44ADA: Professionals (doctors, lawyers, CAs, etc.) — 50% of gross receipts, receipts ≤ Rs.75 lakh
44AB: Tax audit mandatory if turnover > Rs.1 crore (Rs.10 crore if cash transactions < 5%)

gst_compliance.label: GST Compliance
key_facts: GST registration mandatory if turnover > Rs.20 lakh (Rs.10 lakh in special category states)
Composition scheme: turnover ≤ Rs.1.5 crore, pay flat GST, no ITC
GSTR-1: Monthly/quarterly outward supplies filing
GSTR-3B: Monthly tax payment return

home_loan.label: Home Loan Tax Benefits
key_facts: Interest on self-occupied property: max deduction Rs.2 lakh in Old Regime (Section 24b). NOT available in New Regime.
Principal repayment: Rs.1,50,000 under 80C in Old Regime
Let-out property: No cap on interest deduction (but set-off against other income capped at Rs.2 lakh/year)
Under-construction: Interest during construction period deductible in 5 equal instalments post-possession

tds_other.label: TDS on Non-Salary Income
key_facts: 194A: TDS on FD interest — threshold raised to Rs.50,000 (Rs.1,00,000 for senior citizens) from FY 2025-26
194I: TDS on rent — 2% (plant/machinery), 10% (land/building) if rent > Rs.50,000/month
194J: TDS on professional fees — 10% (professional), 2% (technical services)
194C: TDS on contractor payments — 1% (individual), 2% (company)
194S: TDS on VDA/crypto — 1% on amount > Rs.10,000

section_87a.label: Section 87A Tax Rebate
key_facts: New Regime FY 2025-26: Rebate of Rs.60,000 if total income ≤ Rs.12,00,000 (effectively zero tax up to Rs.12L)
Old Regime: Rebate of Rs.12,500 if total income ≤ Rs.5,00,000
SPECIAL RATES (STCG 20%, LTCG 12.5%, crypto 30%) are NOT eligible for 87A rebate
Surcharge income is also NOT eligible for 87A rebate

surcharge.label: Surcharge and Marginal Relief
key_facts: Surcharge slabs: 10% (50L-1Cr), 15% (1Cr-2Cr), 25% (2Cr-5Cr), 25% (>5Cr) — New Regime
Old Regime: 37% surcharge for income > 5 Cr (equity/STCG/LTCG capped at 15%)
Marginal relief available to prevent effective rate > 100% at the threshold
Health & Education Cess: 4% on (income tax + surcharge)

itr_deadline.label: ITR Filing Deadlines
key_facts: Original return: July 31, 2026 (for FY 2025-26, AY 2026-27)
Belated return: December 31, 2026 — with penalty Rs.5,000 (Rs.1,000 if income < Rs.5L)
Interest under 234A: 1% per month on outstanding tax from due date
Revised return: December 31, 2026 (if original was filed on time)
Updated return (ITR-U): 24 months from assessment year end — with 25% or 50% additional tax

nri_taxation.label: NRI Taxation
key_facts: NRI: Indian-sourced income taxable in India
DTAA relief: Tax paid abroad can be credited against Indian tax
NRO account: Taxable interest (TDS 30%)
NRE account: Tax-free interest
No 87A rebate for NRIs
Higher TDS rates apply to NRIs on capital gains

gift_tax.label: Gift Taxation
key_facts: Gifts from specified relatives (parents, siblings, spouse, etc.): EXEMPT — no limit
Gifts from non-relatives: Taxable as 'Other Sources' if total gifts > Rs.50,000/year
Gift vouchers from employer: Taxable as perquisite if value > Rs.15,000/year (Rule 3, IT Rules 2026 — increased from Rs.5,000 under old rules)
On marriage: All gifts exempt regardless of source or amount
Inherited property: Exempt (not a gift)

fd_interest.label: Fixed Deposit Interest Taxation
key_facts: FD interest: Fully taxable at slab rate as 'Income from Other Sources'
TDS 10% if annual interest > Rs.50,000 (raised from Rs.40,000 — Budget 2025)
Senior citizens: TDS threshold Rs.1,00,000 (raised from Rs.50,000)
Section 80TTA: Savings account interest exempt up to Rs.10,000 (NOT FD interest)
Section 80TTB: Senior citizens (60+) — Rs.50,000 exemption on ALL bank/post office interest including FDs
Accrual basis: FD interest is taxable yearly even if not yet paid

professional_tax.label: Professional Tax
key_facts: State-level tax — varies by state
Deductible from salary income (below-the-line deduction)
Maximum Rs.2,500/year
Available in BOTH Old and New Regime as deduction from salary

section_54.label: Section 54 Exemption (Property)
key_facts: Exempt LTCG by buying 1 residential property: within 1 year before OR 2 years after sale
OR by constructing a house within 3 years
Capital Gains Account Scheme (CGAS): Deposit unused amount in bank before ITR due date
From AY 2024-25: Exemption capped at Rs.10 crore
Must hold new property for 3 years — else gain is taxable in year of sale

other_income.label: Other Sources Income
key_facts: Dividends: Taxable at slab rate (post April 2020 — DDT abolished)
TDS 10% on dividends > Rs.5,000/year
Lottery/gambling/online gaming: Flat 30% + cess, no deductions allowed (Section 115BB/115BBJ)
Online gaming TDS: 30% on net winnings (Section 194BA)
